guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook

International Omnipod | 32% - 33% | 30% - 32%
Total Omnipod | 21.5% - 22.5% | 21% - 23%
Drug Delivery | ~(40%) | ~(40%)
Total | 21% - 22% | 20% - 22%
